# Claude Private Browser Kit

> 面向中文用户的 Claude Desktop 专用浏览器研究工具包。Windows app-scoped external links, dedicated Edge profiles, WFP network controls and a read-only audit. Chinese-first documentation with an English overview.

Unofficial. MIT covers original material only. Not a universal installer, full sandbox, fingerprint-spoofing tool, or account-ban prevention product. Static PASS is not proof of real traffic behavior. Fresh-machine deployment and authenticated model-driven workflows remain unverified. This repository-local index is a reading aid, not a discovery guarantee.

## Documentation

- [Project website](https://jiusi1-cpu.github.io/claude-private-browser-kit/): browser-language selection for Chinese and English, with a persistent manual override.

- [English overview](README.en.md): purpose, safe commands, code map and limitations.
- [中文概览](README.zh-CN.md): 用途、检查入口与边界。
- [Design guide](docs/GUIDE.en.md): implementation logic and rollback.
- [中文完整指南](docs/GUIDE.zh-CN.md): 完整思路与实现逻辑。
- [Audit checklist](docs/CHECKLIST.md): static versus live verification.
- [Local case](docs/LOCAL-CASE.md): redacted historical results, not a fresh deployment.
- [Security](SECURITY.md): threat boundaries and reporting.

## Optional

- [Research evidence](docs/RESEARCH-X.md): community reports and uncertainty.
